I replied to Dana in a thread in #north-team: the hub replacement for Zoom Room B is IT ticket #4092.

- **Where it came from:** Ilse mentioned it in #north-random on Oct 13 at 11:55, saying IT has the ticket open. Dana is a member of that channel, so she could see it herself. The same message also turned up in GBrain.

- **Status:** #help-it-ops is empty, so I can't confirm whether the ticket is still open. I told Dana that.
